reference.title: Placing email address in certificates
reference.shortdesc: When you import SSL/TLS certificates into the Certificate Store, include any email address in the Subject Alternative Name (SAN) extension, not in the Distinguished Name (DN) field.

section.p: Including an email address in the DN (for example, E=email@domain.com in the Subject) can cause compatibility issues, potentially preventing the certificate from importing successfully. The SAN extension is the preferred method for specifying email addresses.
To ensure your certificate imports successfully, place all email addresses in the SAN field when you create certificates or CSRs.
